# self-update: refactor the script

Rework `bin/self-update`. **Motivation:** [#544](DOT-456.md) and the [Homebrew discussion](https://github.com/orgs/Homebrew/discussions/4495) on `brew bundle` re-tapping: "when I untapped taps and ran `self-update`, it downloaded taps again" — `brew bundle` installs whatever the Brewfile declares, including `tap` lines, so removing a tap by hand is undone on the next update; the state should be driven by the file, and the script should make that explicit rather than fight it.
